reminders.note: Zulrah poisons you on every hit — bring antivenom(+). A ring of suffering (ri) or ring of recoil chips some retaliation damage back.

Vorkath breathes dragonfire (Protect from Magic plus an antifire potion covers it, no shield needed) and poisons you during the acid phase — bring antivenom(+). A dragonfire shield/ward or anti-dragon shield still helps if you'd rather not rely on potion doses.
Breathes dragonfire — Protect from Magic plus an antifire (or extended antifire) potion covers it without needing a shield; a dragonfire shield/ward or anti-dragon shield works too.
Metal dragons' dragonfire pierces Protect from Magic — a dragonfire shield/ward or a super antifire potion is mandatory here, not just a prayer.
Bring antivenom+. Its poison phase is venom-tier and escalates — plain antipoison only knocks it down to poison, it does not cure it.
Bring antipoison. The poison fumes in its first phase start at 8 damage and keep ticking.
Bring antidote++ or a sanfew serum. His melee can poison you starting at 16 damage, and it lands even through Protect from Melee.
Bring antipoison or antidote++. Her Smoke phase — Smoke Rush and the smoke clouds — can poison you.
Bring antipoison for the walk in — the tunnel to her lair is full of poison spiders. Cerberus herself does not poison you.
